notable_absence.finding: The page states a real tradeoff - 'You can get the maximum indexing throughput by setting the maxFeedsPerDCPAgent value to 1. However, it results in higher resource utilization' - but this is a tradeoff between two VALUES of the same single setting (1 vs. the default 6), not between two different concepts, so the promoted tradesOffAgainst predicate (designed for two distinct constructs, e.g. Hyperscale vs Composite Vector Index) was not used here to avoid a self-referencing subject/object relation. Noted as a finding instead.
